description: Formal indoor group photograph of seven elderly people posed in two rows before a large tapestry: four men in suits standing behind three seated women. Ted Turner stands at far left, George Soros third from left, and David Rockefeller at far right; the second standing man and the three seated women are not identified with certainty. The setting and grouping are consistent with a philanthropy/society gathering; the image circulated online with captions asserting elite connections.
flags: One standing man and the three seated women are unidentified; online captions naming them are unverified.

description: Photograph of Pope Francis in white papal cassock posed indoors with a delegation of six people in dark formal dress, five men and one woman, in a small room with a framed religious drawing on the wall. The image is consistent with a Vatican audience for a World Jewish Congress delegation, and the original filename (rothschilddavidwjcyfranc.jpg) claims David de Rothschild and the WJC are pictured with Francis. Apart from the pope, the delegation members are not identified from the image itself.
flags: Filename claims David de Rothschild and a World Jewish Congress delegation; identities of the six delegation members are not verified from the image.

description: Composite image placing two separate photographs side by side over a fiery orange background: George Soros smiling and shaking an unseen person’s hand, and Jacob Rothschild in a tuxedo and bow tie holding a champagne glass. The flame backdrop and crude cut-outs give the collage a villainous framing; the two men do not appear together in a single original photo here.
flags: Composite/edited image, not a genuine single photograph of the two men together.

description: Photograph of Pope Francis bowing to kiss the hand of an elderly man wearing a kippah, with a Franciscan friar, a man in a suit, and other onlookers around them in a dark stone-walled hall. The scene is consistent with the widely published images of Francis kissing the hands of Holocaust survivors at Yad Vashem’s Hall of Remembrance in Jerusalem during his May 2014 visit. The survivors and bystanders are private individuals and are not identified.
flags: Location/date inferred from the scene’s match to the documented 2014 Yad Vashem visit, not shown in the image; elderly survivors are private individuals and left unnamed.

description: Photograph of Barack Obama in a dark suit speaking into a handheld microphone while standing on a staircase in an upscale modern interior, gesturing to a crowd of well-dressed guests gathered on both sides. The setting appears to be a private reception or fundraiser in a home or gallery; the venue, date, and attendees are not identified from the image. The framing and lighting suggest an editorial/magazine photograph.
flags: Venue, date, and event unverified; attendees are private individuals and left unnamed.
